result.topic_en: Gauss derives second-order differential equations satisfied by the power series $1+\frac14 k^2+\frac{1.9}{4.16}k^4+\dots$ (in $\sin 2\varphi$, $\operatorname{tg}\varphi$, and $f$), which equals the reciprocal of the arithmetic-geometric mean $M(1+f,1-f)$, and poses the problem of finding the differential equation whose integral is $2r/M(\alpha+\beta x,\gamma+\delta x)$.
result.transcription:
Es sei die Reihe $1+\frac14\sin 2\varphi^2+\frac{1.9}{4.16}\sin 2\varphi^4+ \;= P$
so ist
$\frac12\sin 2\varphi^2+\frac{1.9}{4.4}\sin 2\varphi^4+ \;= \operatorname{tg}2\varphi . P'$
$\sin 2\varphi^2+\frac{1.9}{4}\sin 2\varphi^4+ \;= \frac14\operatorname{tg}2\varphi^2 . P'' + \frac12\cdot\frac{\operatorname{tg}2\varphi}{\cos 2\varphi^2}. P'$
$\operatorname{tg}2\varphi+\frac34\sin 2\varphi^3+\frac{1.9.5}{4.16}\sin 2\varphi^5+ \;= \frac12\operatorname{tg}2\varphi.\sin 4\varphi . P' + \sin 2\varphi . P$
$\sin 2\varphi+\frac94\sin 2\varphi^3+\frac{1.9.25}{4.16}\sin 2\varphi^5+ \;= \frac14\operatorname{tg}2\varphi^2\sin 4\varphi P'' + \frac{2cs\,c^4[?]+ss}{2c^3} P' + \sin 2\varphi . P$
Also $\frac14\sin 2\varphi^2 P'' + \frac{\sin 2\varphi - 2\sin 2\varphi^3}{2\cos 2\varphi}P' - \sin 2\varphi^2 . P = 0$
oder $\frac14\sin 2\varphi + \frac{1-2\sin 2\varphi^2}{2\cos 2\varphi}P' - \sin 2\varphi . P = 0$
Man betrachte ferner die Reihe
$1+\frac14\operatorname{tg}\varphi^4+\frac{1.9}{4.16}\operatorname{tg}\varphi^8 \ldots = Q\cos\varphi^2$
$\frac12\sin\varphi\cos\varphi$ | $\frac12\operatorname{tg}\varphi^4 + \;= \frac12 sc^3 Q' - ccss\, Q$
$P = 1+\frac14 ff+\frac14\cdot\frac{9}{16}f^4+\ldots = \frac{1}{M(1+f,1-f)}$
$f\frac{dP}{df} = \frac24 ff + \frac14\cdot\frac94 f^4 + \frac{1.9.25}{4.16.6}f^6$
$\frac{f\,fdP}{df} = \frac14\cdot\frac84 f^4 \quad \frac14\cdot\frac{9}{16}\cdot\frac{24}{6}$
$(1-f^2)\frac{dP}{df} = \frac24 ff + \frac14\cdot\frac14 f^4 + \frac{1.9}{4.16.6}f^6$
$ffP = ff+\frac14 f^4+\frac14\frac{9}{16}f^6$
$\frac12 f P' = [-fP-(1-ff)\frac{dP}{df}-]$ \quad $fP - P$
$\frac{P(xx-yy)}{4f(1-f^2)} + \frac{P}{4f(1-ff)}\{x'x'-y'y' + 2f(x'x'-y'y')\}$
$\frac{M}{8f.M^2}\Big\{\frac{1}{1+f}\{xx-yy+2f(x'x'-y'y')\} + \frac{1}{1-f}\{xx-yy-2f(x'x'-y'y')\}$
$\frac{2r}{M(a+x,b+x)}$
Invenire aequationem diff. cuius integrale
$y=\frac{2r}{M(\alpha+\beta x,\gamma+\delta x)}$

methods.what: Power series for reciprocal of the arithmetic-geometric mean
Termwise differentiation of the series in $\sin 2\varphi$ to express auxiliary series via P', P''
Second-order linear differential equation satisfied by P as function of φ
Analogous series in tan φ^4 related to Q cos^2 φ
Termwise manipulation of series in f to derive differential equation for P(f)
